# Trial Version Service Update

Hello, and thank you for your continued support!
Please note that the Trial Version service will be officially discontinued on **September 7, 2025**.

Don't worry—all features from the trial version have been fully integrated and will be regularly updated within the Professional Version. When you upgrade, you'll keep all the familiar functionality while unlocking new advanced features and exclusive services.

New customers can get a **7-day free trial**. Upgrade now to experience a more professional and personalized service!

**Professional Version Download Link**：https://www.meta.com/experiences/24070258989326707

=====

Break free from traditional training methods with immersive MR emergency simulations.
By integrating Mixed Reality and interactive hand-tracking technology, this solution delivers a highly intuitive training experience with real-time feedback and full learning history recording.
This program follows the American Heart Association (AHA) public guidelines for CPR and AED training, ensuring compliance with international standards.
Rescue actions are naturally replicated, training effectiveness becomes visible, and instructional quality and emergency response efficiency are greatly enhanced — ushering in a new era of emergency simulation training.

If you have any questions, suggestions, or wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us at:
huagingofficial@gmail.com
